sources.summary: Human Rights Watch (29 Oct 2025): the leaked omnibus '11th Judicial Package' would amend penal-code article 225 so that acts 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' carry up to 3 years and same-sex engagement or marriage ceremonies up to 4 years; amend civil-code article 40 ('Changing Sex') to raise the gender-affirming care minimum age from 18 to 25 with mandatory infertility and government-approved hospital evaluation; and imprison care providers up to 7 years and trans patients up to 3 years. National-level document; no province-specific content for this unit.

Kaos GL's LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025 (launched in Ankara, 24 Feb 2026): in 2025 anti-LGBTI+ hostility became explicit state policy — presidential and 'Year of the Family' institutional directives, religious-authority and broadcasting-regulator censorship, one LGBTI+ rights organisation closed; six violations of the right to life documented (three hate-motivated killings, trans people most affected), 89 torture/ill-treatment violations (51 the previous year), 313 liberty violations (about 2.5x the previous year, mostly detention procedure). National monitoring with no provincial breakdown.

tangentialFactors: Draft same-sex-conduct criminalisation (the leaked 11th Judicial Package, Oct 2025: up to 3-4 years) and 2025's institutionalised hostility (six right-to-life violations, 313 liberty violations, one LGBTI+ organisation closed) are national-LGB-and-trans factors that shape police and official posture toward gender-nonconforming people in this province as well; public-activity bans by governors in peer provinces signal the same climate.
localsOnly: The civil code's 'Changing Sex' provisions — gender-marker procedure, and the leaked draft's proposed care-age rise to 25 with mandatory infertility and government-approved hospital evaluation — plus the Health Ministry's trans-healthcare regulations bear on residents rather than visitors.
